subject: Service restitution framework proposal — GreenBridge latency disruption
messages:
From: Sara Foley <sara.foley@greenbridge.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2027 14:08:00 -0400
Subject: Latency incident impact — request for remediation plan

Jordan,

We experienced repeated high-latency spikes and a few 5xx failures against your hosted endpoint between 2027-09-12 03:00 UTC and 2027-09-12 07:40 UTC. The effect was visible in our payments pipeline (transaction timeouts) and triggered several customer support tickets.

We need a remediation proposal and a commercial remediation (credit or settlement) to cover incremental costs and customer rebates while we work through our SLAs with downstream partners. Attached are a few payment-failure samples and the GreenBridge incident log for your reference (payment-failure-samples.log).

Can you confirm: 1) the root cause investigation timeline, 2) proposed credit or settlement structure, and 3) when the credit will be applied to invoices? Our procurement and finance teams are awaiting a formal offer to approve the amendment.

This is high priority for us — please escalate as needed.

Thanks,
Sara Foley
Head of Platform Reliability
GreenBridge Financial

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Foley <sara.foley@greenbridge.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Latency incident impact — request for remediation plan

Forwarding Sara's note — impact to GBX production during 2027-09-12 window. They specifically asked for a remediation credit and timeline.

Internal ask: Ben / Marissa — can you draft a commercial remediation that balances our policy with the strategic value of GreenBridge? Current committed monthly spend: ~$150k. Their procurement team will need numbers this week to approve an SOW amendment.

Relevant artifacts: JIRA ticket JIRA-GBX-458, HubSpot record GBX-789. I've attached the log they sent.

-Jordan

On Wed, Sep 15, 2027 at 2:08 PM Sara Foley <sara.foley@greenbridge.com> wrote:
> Jordan,
> 
> We experienced repeated high-latency spikes... [trimmed] 
> 
> (attachment: payment-failure-samples.log)
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 17 Sep 2027 10:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Latency incident impact — request for remediation plan

Thanks for the ping. I've run preliminary cost/impact math and drafted a settlement framework for exec consideration. Key points: 1) Incident appears to be an outage of a regional edge cache that increased tail latency for ~4.5 hours; operations has provided a post-mortem draft and we'll finalize RCA by EOD tomorrow. 2) Policy baseline: standard SLA credit = pro-rated uptime credit (up to 30% monthly) but our commercial playbook allows negotiated one-time credits for strategic customers.

Proposed remediation (conservative + escalated option):
- Conservative: one-time credit equal to 25% of their average monthly committed spend (~$37.5k) applied to next invoice.
- Escalated (recommended): two free full service months (waive two months of committed fees, estimated value $300k) plus a one-time technical support credit for incident investigation costs (~$12k).

Rationale: GreenBridge is a marquee financial customer in the US region; the escalated offer is larger than standard playbook but protects long-term ARR and reduces churn risk. This level requires VP-level approval for departures >20% of monthly ARR.

I've attached the proposed settlement table (proposed_settlement_table.xlsx) and a draft amendment link (DocuSign) for ease of acceptance. Please advise if we should route to Sales leadership for one-off approval; if so, Marissa, can you confirm?

- Ben

(attachments: proposed_settlement_table.xlsx)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Finance Billing <finance-billing@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Sep 2027 08:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Latency incident impact — request for remediation plan

Agree with Ben. GreenBridge is strategically important and the escalated remediation is justified to preserve the account. Approve the escalated package: waive two months of committed fees (value ~ $300k) and apply a one-time $12k support credit. Jordan — please confirm acceptance language with GreenBridge and attach the amendment. Aditya / Finance: please confirm how quickly the credit posts to the customer's ledger once DocuSign is returned. Legal to prepare a short amendment to add the credit and an SLA appendix; route to Sara and procurement for signature.

Marissa
VP Sales, Redwood Inference

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Sara Foley <sara.foley@greenbridge.com>, procure@greenbridge.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Sep 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Latency incident impact — request for remediation plan

Sara — thanks again for raising this and for the initial logs. We are prepared to offer the accelerated remediation package: two waived service months (estimate value $300k) + $12k one-time support credit. Legal has prepared an amendment; signing link is here: https://docusign.com/embedded/sign?env=prod&doc=GBX-amend-09.

Next steps:
- Sara/procurement to review and sign amendment (DocuSign link above).
- Once signed, Finance will apply the credit to the next invoice cycle (Aditya — can you confirm expected posting timeframe?).
- Operational RCA will be finalized and shared tomorrow; I'll include the post-mortem with technical remediation items.

Attachments included for your records: latency_log_20270912.csv, proposed_settlement_table.xlsx (summary).

Regards,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwood.com
